Narrow curtain indoor motion detector providing reliable and stable
performance up to a range of 6m (20ft.). Ideal for protecting
windows, hallways, doors and a variety of other commercial and
residential applications.
AP2-20N
Motion detection and smart automation
Reliable motion detection
with a range of up to 6 m (20ft.)
Easy installation in wall or ceiling
creating a curtain detection area
Flexible mounting height
between 2.4 - 3.6 m (8ft. to 12ft.)
